set.description: 전용 준비대3×1, 계량/절단/완성병 트레이 사용면을 상판에 구분. 서쪽 계량자와 북쪽 보조자가 사용하며 저울·절구·칼/도마는 별도 mixing-tools 원본.

geometry.coordinates: All rects half-open; top_y and contact_y are inclusive local pixel rows.
geometry.formula: tableTL = groundCell*16 - table.origin; support = tableTL + [cellOffsetX*16+8,15]; propTL = support - prop.contact; placement.pixel = propTL + prop.origin

production.instructions:
전용 준비대3×1, 계량/절단/완성병 트레이 사용면을 상판에 구분. 서쪽 계량자와 북쪽 보조자가 사용하며 저울·절구·칼/도마는 별도 mixing-tools 원본.
Read current sceneContract, theme-brief.json and concept-art.png. Use only the dedicated 42 colours. No stock artwork or palette. Logical ground cells remain fixed; rendered pixels are the resolved ground/support/hood anchors in scene-contract.json. Use the approved 23x14 coordinates. Read approved planning and compare each required attachment, footprint and actor scale; no room PASS before complete native coverage.
Read scene-contract and attachment-contract: teacher sole(136,47)/hand(150,42), assistant sole(328,127)/hand(328,123), same sole in walking/action. North bodies behind tables, hand/tool separate above top. Board pixel(96,0), readable rect(98,2,126,14). Five named new cut-vault rib parents are ordered, with in-range source sockets. Lower exhaust endpoints(40,102)/(152,102) on ribs in y98..105 gap; continuous duct-return alpha behind upper bench fascia, not terminating at table front. Each slot contact/inlet/exhaust is an actual in-range pixel; boundary endpoints separately declared. Use only42 theme colours. Verify real native PNG alpha and all three comparison regions before verdict.
